text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Early February— Today, I went shopping 
together with Winning Ticket."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Towels check! Sports drinks check! 
Compresses and cooling spray are good to 
go too!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I guess that takes care of all our 
training equipment. I'm gonna run my heart 
out this month too~~!
choice_data_list:
Thanks for coming along on the shopping 
trip.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
No need to thank me! I'm the one who's 
gonna be using the gear anyway.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I was just thinking about going 
shopping myself anyway.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, ingredients for handmade 
chocolates!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Look, Valentine's Day is coming right up, 
right? I promised my friends I'd exchange 
chocolates with them!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Of course I'll give some to you too, 
Trainer-san! Just sit tight and look 
forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And on Valentine's Day itself—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The students of the academy seem to be 
enjoying this day to the fullest, but...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Hmmmm...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, remember how we talked before about 
exchanging chocolates with everyone?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
And so, on my way to training just now, a 
friend gave me some chocolate...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Why give it to me now? Valentine's 
Eve?
choice_data_list: You haven't given anything in return?
Haven't you given anything in return?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I haven't! I mean, Valentine's Day is 
tomorrow, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"WOOOOOOOO~~~~!!!! I got the date 
wrooooong~~~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
So THAT'S why everyone had that 
exasperated look on their faces when they 
gave me chocolate?! Aaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"You could've at least told me, 'It's 
today!' Waaaaaahhh!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I'll apologize and give it to them 
tomorrow. I'll give Trainer's tomorrow 
too, then...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Valentine's Day ended up being a 
day late for Winning Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...No matter how long I wait, Winning 
Ticket doesn't show up for training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After asking her classmates and hearing 
that she rushed back to the dorm, I went 
to check on her, only to find...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm sorry! I forgot to message 
you that I'd be late for training!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Actually, some fans gave me chocolate this 
morning...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That's when I realized Valentine's Day is 
today!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
If it weren't for the fans, I'd probably 
still be training without even noticing~!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, to all my fans~~! 
Waaaahhhhhh~~!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, I started making it, thinking 
there was still just barely enough time to 
finish."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
In exchange, I might be a little late for 
training, though...
choice_data_list:
I'll be waiting, so give it all you've 
got!
I'll be waiting, so do your best!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Trainer!! Thaaank yooouuu~~!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All right, time to make a massive 
comeback~! I'm gonna make chocolate 
everyone will love!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"I'll bring some for you too, Trainer, so 
look forward to it!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Winning Ticket brought 
chocolates to training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because it was brought over before it 
fully set, it had lost its shape a bit, 
but it was still delicious chocolate 
filled with heartfelt thought.
